notes: The San Francisco Call's daily Building Contracts list for 1906 as curiv_hercules_ver01 holds it: every issue from 1 April to 31 December (5,188 OCR pages); January to March 1906 is in another batch and was not read. Located on the 1907 shapes - the list's heading, 'with CONTRACTOR - WORK ... line/corner of ...; $AMOUNT', a storey count within 200 characters of 'line of'/'corner of' - and two more 1906 needed: 'with X, to erect' with a comma for the dash, and '(owner)' after the owner's name, the form the list took before the fire; 159 page-blocks on 145 days. The list is absent from 18 April to late June: the fire stopped it, and it came back in July. Every one of the 1,373 candidate segments was read by hand by one reader; 141 are not entries (32 news paragraphs, 30 debris, 29 garbled past reading, 28 fragments, 14 advertisements, 6 duplicates, 2 deeds), and 27 entries the OCR ran into the entry before were read as entries of their own. The list prints the owner before 'with', so the end of each segment is the next entry's owner: private owners, estates and trustees are cut from raw and extra, the quote starting at 'with' and ending at the entry's own amount. Institutional and company owners are kept in extra.owner_firm, a named building in extra.building_name, and notable past owners in extra.notable_owner (Claus Spreckels, M. H. de Young, James L. Flood, H. H. Bancroft, A. Ruef). A contractor's name read only as a guess is kept in extra.contractors_guessed and printed as 'a builder'. Montgomery avenue is Columbus, Dupont Grant, Point Lobos Geary, East street the Embarcadero, H street Lincoln Way, Devisadero Divisadero. Placed with corner.py --batch --json, a lot pass, an offset pass and a corner pass, on the 1907 rule with 1906 for the year (an alteration a building standing by 1905); a lot that can be measured and does not match never falls back to the corner pass. Downtown, corner.py's estimate of where two streets cross can be far enough off to put a parcel in the wrong quadrant, so every placement was also tested against each street's own centreline, fitted from its EAS points and centred between the two sides: a corner needs corner.py's quadrant, the robust side test and an outline within 65 ft of both centrelines (or EAS addresses on both streets), a line both side tests; 23 placements the two tests disagreed on were refused. Contracts let before the 18 April fire for lots in the district that burned are never placed by geometry: the building they name burned. Named buildings placed by name where the page carries it: the Sentinel Building, the Flood building, the Bank of California, the Claus Spreckels building and its annex, the Mutual Savings Bank, the Italian American Bank, the Merchants' Exchange, the French Savings Bank, the Alaska Commercial building, the German Hospital and St. Mark's Lutheran Church. Only 21 entries print a street number; resolve_eas refuses or cannot find 20, and 113-117 Central Avenue was placed by hand against its cross streets. One parcel is one page, and one entry per building: the general contract, else the earliest, carries the page's entry.

coverage.remaining: January to March 1906 is not in curiv_hercules_ver01 and is unread. Of April to December nothing is known to remain: 159 page-blocks on 145 days located and read whole; days without a block are Mondays, holidays, the weeks after the fire when the list did not run, and days whose OCR lost every shape, which were not hand-searched. Of the 1,068 unresolved, 369 have no parcel matching the lot or offset with a roll year near 1906, 294 single candidates were refused (side, roll year, storeys, offset, not the corner lot), 27 match several parcels, 92 are on a street that does not meet the cross street or run that way in EAS, 23 were refused by the centreline test, 7 were let before the fire in the district that burned, 230 could not be measured (an illegible field, no cross street, a tract lot), 20 print a number resolve_eas refuses or cannot find, and 6 name a building no page carries.
coverage.note: 5,188 OCR pages scanned (every page of 1 April - 31 December 1906 in curiv_hercules_ver01); 159 page-blocks kept; 1,373 candidate segments read, 141 of them not entries, 1,232 contract entries and 27 run-on entries inside them - 1,259 findings (1,193 building contracts, 66 alterations). 191 resolved by hand on 154 parcels - 158 by lot, offset and corner with corner.py's geometry, 33 on a building the record names or a number checked by hand - and 1,068 unresolved, each with its reason. 145 published on 145 pages; 46 declined, 37 further contracts for a building whose entry already carries one and 9 contradicting what the page already records.
